title: The SSRM Create Modpack
description: The SSRM Modpack but with Create
body:
# The SSRM Create Modpack
_The SSRM Create Modpack_ is a Create-based modpack built for engineers, builders, and system-designers who want their world to feel like a living machine. Designed with the SSRM mindset — efficient, organized, and mission-ready — this pack rewards players who love turning raw materials into perfectly running production systems.

From hidden hillside workshops to full-scale industrial districts, you’ll build factories that look as good as they function — powered by the satisfying motion, sound, and mechanical depth of Create.

_Created By_

_ShoopADeDoopDoop & AngelBond14_
